scenario_summary: Negative example: accurate report of the Montes traffic stop incident. All claims faithfully reflect the DA investigation.

claims.claim_text: I conducted a traffic stop on a black Mercedes Benz, California plate 8YQZ992, at 100 S. McClay Street due to expired registration tags.
claims.explanation: Vehicle description, plate, location, and reason for stop all match the DA investigation.

claims.claim_text: The vehicle had three occupants: W-1 driving, the subject in the right front passenger seat, and W-2 in the right rear.
claims.explanation: Correctly identifies all three occupants and their positions.

claims.claim_text: W-1 also disclosed he was on AB109 supervision.
claims.explanation: The DA letter confirms John Doe 1 stated he was on AB109.

claims.claim_text: The subject lifted a bag of food with his left hand from his lap and placed it on the center console, then began texting on his cell phone.
claims.explanation: Matches the DA letter's description of Montes lifting food and texting.

claims.claim_text: The subject reached over his body with his left hand and locked the door.

evidence_references.visual_description: Subject reaches across and pushes door lock down.

claims.explanation: Accurately describes the door-locking action documented in the DA investigation at 2:04:20 PM.

claims.claim_text: The subject then reached down on his right side with his right hand, lifted a black semi-automatic handgun, and transitioned it to his left hand.
claims.explanation: Matches the DA letter's description of Montes reaching down, lifting the handgun with his right hand, and transitioning to his left.

claims.claim_text: I fired six rounds from my duty weapon. Officer Yoon, positioned behind the car at the curb, fired one round while backing away.
claims.explanation: Correctly states Buan fired 6 and Park fired 1, matching the forensic analysis in the DA letter.

claims.claim_text: A K9 unit responded at approximately 1409 hours. The K9 was released into the vehicle but the subject was unresponsive.
claims.explanation: K9 arrival at ~2:09 PM and deployment at ~2:14 PM are documented in the DA letter.

claims.claim_text: Officers breached the car and found the subject in the right front passenger seat with a loaded handgun on his left thigh.
claims.explanation: DA letter confirms the handgun was on Montes' left thigh when officers breached the vehicle.

claims.claim_text: The subject was pronounced deceased at 1430 hours.
claims.explanation: The DA letter states the subject was transported and pronounced deceased, but the exact time of pronouncement at 2:30 PM is stated in the investigation. Whether this precise time is audible on bodycam is uncertain.
